verification.notes: DOJ and FBI records establish government possession and use of extensive device, cloud, message, financial, and witness evidence. records.text: During my father's four years in office, I did no business and became a painter.

verification.notes: Hunter Biden did leave prior corporate-board work and became a painter during Joe Biden's presidency. verification.notes: Joe Biden has repeatedly said that when elected to the Senate he pledged never to own an individual stock or bond and later described the pledge as maintained. records.speaker: Hunter Biden
